environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed as a containerized image running on EKS Fargate with the Lambda Runtime Interface Emulator. The EKS cluster enforces Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' profile (namespace label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The Fargate profile's underlying execution environment applies a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) that filters connect() syscalls to metadata endpoints. Additionally, the VPC security group attached to the Fargate ENI has egress rules limited to the DynamoDB VPC endpoint (pl-prefix-list) on port 443 only — no NAT gateway, no internet gateway route in the subnet route table. The pod runs as non-root (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534) with readOnlyRootFilesystem and no hostPath volumes permitted by the PSS restricted profile.

network.subnet_route_table: local + VPC endpoint only, no igw, no nat
